review_text: The food was good and anything we ordered was available. Except of Gelato (ice cream), nothing available. Pizza is very well done in a wooden stone brick oven. First meal serving was very fast, but later the empty plates stays until the end (more than 40 minutes) on our table.

First time trying this Italian food spot. Love the ambiance of the place, calm and cozy. The food was good! Don't sleep on their roasted porchetta dish, the pork was tender and flavorful. The pesto pasta could be improved. Pizza was really fresh and light. I recommend going here on lunch time when it's less crowded.

The place exudes a warm and inviting atmosphere, making it a delightful spot to visit. Their chocolate fudge is an absolute treat, and their polvoron is simply the best you'll ever taste. It's a must-try for anyone seeking a sweet indulgence. Additionally, they have a bistro that offers a variety of dining options, making it a perfect destination for a satisfying meal.

I personally love this place because of its atmosphere and food. They serve delicious food here specially their mains and pizzas. Serving size can feed 1-2 people, their gelato flavors are very interesting, food is served in a timely manner, has reasonable prices, and the staff is also attentive. Nice place to chill with friends and loved ones.
The home away feom home. Great food. Ambiance is really cozy and Great service.

Food was good, waiters were helpful. But upon encountering a problem with our order, we were not even informed it was cancelled or that it was never coming at all. We just waited until it was time to bill out and actually billed out without it. That was not good.

Went there for a late lunch so the place is not packed. Food is nice, ambiance is nice too. Staff are friendly and attentive. Love their truffle cream pasta, reminds me of Mama Lou's but with a more subtle flavor. Serving can be good for two, had a hard time finishing a plate.

Every bite is a blissful escape into a world of exquisite flavors! Their dishes are a burst of flavors – a symphony for your taste buds they say. I could just not recommend one, because all that we tried are a must try! Love the ambiance too! They are open from 10:30 am. Lots of food to try in this gem! Though the bistro is already operating years back, finding it is like discovering a hidden treasure in the world of flavors.

We were recommend to try their pizza. We started with a salad which was amazing, and then the thin crust Chicken Alfredo Pizza (ordered extra cheese🍕) came out. WOW! Baked in a proper wood fired brick oven. The ambience and service is wonderful. Oh, they also have Gelato, Coffee, Smoothies & Shakes, and a Fudge, and sweets. You've gotta try this place!

We were sat near the brick oven, it was a nice ambiance. Place was fully packed but the staff were very attentive. Pizzas are made per order so expect there will be a bit of waiting time, but it's sooo worth it! All the food we ordered were great! We had seafood marinara, quattro formaggi, tomato and basil soup, and the hot chocolate as well. Will go back again for sure! Cheers!

This is a very cozy restaurant with an excellent view. Parking is slightly a challenge since it is limited. The waiter was excellent in letting us sit inside while it was crowded hats off for their customer service 👏 the ambiance is superb, and the cleanliness is super plus. My overall experience is one that I highly recommend for anyone who wants to have a pleasant meal and superb experience with loved ones, business partners, or friends.this is a must visit in my book, and I will surely come back.

Food was good - we especially loved the mac and cheese! Carbonara was a surprise, we are used to it being creamy but theirs was refreshing because the creaminess was not overwhelming! Not a fan of the Quatro formaggi (4 cheese something pizza) - the texture was a bit dry for me. Service was a bit disappointing, we had to followup our other orders (pizza, pasta, shake) turned out that the server forgot to take note all of them so we basically waited for nothing wondering why they only served us the salad we ordered lol Ambiance was very nice. Space inside is a bit small but there is enough room for everyone. Al fresco area is nice as well. Price reveal at the last photo! 😁

Their Porkchetta is perfect! Love their pizza too. Servers are friendly. Service is prompt. Ambiance is cozy. Editing my old review: This place is famous because they serve delicious dishes. I usually have pasta or pizza. You can have two flavors in your pizza (I think you can even have four). Their coffee is good, as well as their gelato. And yes, their staffs are accommodating as always. This is one of my go-to places here in DC, which I always recommend to my visiting friends.

Always a go-to place for pasta, pizza, and everything in between (as long as they can serve it). However, I wished their service would be better. It's okay, at best. But our server said one of our orders was quick to cook, and still took some 20 minutes to serve. I'm not complaining that much. Still, I would prefer some truth and transparency for the actual serving times.

The place offers a wide selection of Italian comfort food. Quattro formaggi - brick oven pizza with generous cheese toppings with toasty-chewy crust. Oil and cream - based pasta dishes - great texture and authentic flavors, but definitely not "for sharing" as claimed by their staff. Roasted chicken and Osso bucco - fall off the bones, flavorful to the last bite, and not greasy. Carrot walnut cake - the best I have tasted (and I have tasted a lot of carrot cakes!). The cream cheese frosting was not too sweet and not too thick (still melty). The walnut crumb coat provided excellent texture and toasty flavor. Gelatos - do not leave the place without sampling the Lean in New York Cheesecake flavor. Coffee americano - bold and not too acidic. Staff were not too attentive (maybe because there were many customers), but were nice enough not to judge us for our big appetite.

Loved all the food we ate here. We had the insalata caprese, insalata prosciutto as our appetizers and I enjoyed all the elements of our salads. I don't usually like caprese type salads but I loved it. We had frutti di mare pizza and it had generous seafood pieces which I like! Pizza is also oven baked on the spot, I love it. Wish we had more time in Davao to come eat here again.

Fabulous restaurant near the women's college in Juna subdivision. It's walking distance from MTS or even S&R. Stopped in there twice during my long vacation around Davao city. Wish they had marked motorbike parking, bec parking options are scarce. Lots of vegetarian options. Save room for dessert—their carrot walnut cake is heavenly. Will be back next year!

I love the prosciutto & aragula pizza, Manzo al Rosmarino, pears & mesclun salad, chorizo & gambas pasta. Main orders were really great, freshly cooked and smell so good. However, carrot and ube cake were a little of a disappointment. Probably it's a few days old stock and cream cheese frosting had an aftertaste. They also don't serve coffee at the moment. They have an al fresco area if you'd like to dine-in. They installed a hands-free temperature check and sanitizer. Better to call and reserve if you'd like to dine-in. There's parking in front but it can get a little crowded sometimes.
My wife and I's favorite dining place. Never disappoints.

Lara Mia has the look, feel and taste of a Bistro that could be found in Italy or some other European country. Even perhaps in the more affluent communities in the USA like Newport Beach. But Lara Mia is instead in one of the oldest communities of Davao City. Owned by 2 sisters Lara and Marie who both studied in Europe, Lara Mia offers an ecclectic menu ranging from Italian cuisine to French pastries to Filipino traditional favorites. We sampled the gelato, we also sampled their 4 cheese pizza and their prosciutto and arugula pizza as well as their cappuccno. All, without exception, we're excellent. Even the chocolate fudge that was based on a recipe that was passed down by their great grandmother was excellent. There was a constant flow of people at the Bistro but service never suffered. The bistro's decor was also well done. There simply wasn't anything to criticize.

March 2023 — It was a mistake on our part not to ask for their bestsellers, because we unfortunately did not enjoy our meal even though we finished everything. We arrived famished, having skipped both breakfast and lunch, which made the experience even more disappointing. Our order included the Beef Salpicao, Chicken Marsala, Chorizo and Gambas Pasta, Amore Pizza, and both Ube and French Vanilla milkshakes. So, what went wrong? The Beef Salpicao was quite tough and not tender at all. The Chicken Marsala felt undercooked, which was concerning. The Chorizo and Gambas Pasta was dry, and the chorizo was a letdown. Instead of the expected slices, it contained tasteless ground pork mixed with "hard bits" which I couldn't tell if they were bones or tendons, but it was unpleasant. The Amore Pizza meat and cheese were very sparse and poorly distributed. Instead of being spread evenly, the toppings were weirdly stacked on top of each other. Despite the lackluster meal, I'm still open to returning at a different time. I'll definitely skip the mains and try their famous gelato next time instead.
Still feeling the food coma but loved every single dish! Good thing you can opt for cashless payment option e.g., credit card/gcash.

The place is vibrant and very spacious. I like the pasta I ate and the foods looks delicious. This restaurant is good enough to dine and not much expensive. Good enough for families and solos. I recommend to dine for your experience.

Tucked in a quiet neighborhood, Lara Mia Cafe is such a hidden gem! 🌿✨ Who would've thought there's a charming garden cafe right in the middle of the city? Tried their Aglio Olio E Peperoncino—looks simple but WOW, the quality ingredients really shine! 🍝💛 My colleague had the truffle pasta and paired it with their Signature Hot Chocolate, which was rich and indulgent 🍫🤍 The biggest surprise? Their Cookie Butter gelato 🥹✨️ —affordable, generously served, and the perfect sweet ending to a night of chika! 🍨🫶
Delightful Tuscan style resturant with nice garden area outside seating. Food is excellent. Classic Italian style food with nominal Filipino localization. An all together delightful experience.

Great yummy food, affordable price! ❤💕 Nice ambiance and attentive servers. The osso buco and truffle cream pasta are a must-try! :) Lots of dessert to choose from in the cafe front. Outdoor seating available. …
Food: it was SOOO GOOD, especially their mac n cheese broo 🤤🤤❤️ 🔥 Service: they were nice & accomodating Atmosphere: we ate outside and it felt peaceful
We had pink salmon and grilled chicken as mains for lunch and a couple of insalatas. Salad dressing and food flavors were spot on! I was sorry not to try the gelato but there's always next time 🥰

Love the Quattro Formaggi, Marheta Caprese, Proscuitto and Arugula. Also love the Vongole and Lasagna. Plus the entrees, so rich in flavor. The meats are tendered just enough. So far, all the items already tried are all good, including their gelatos. The best!!!

Just gonna do my review in the following criteria for reference. FOOD: The food was overall a delight for us. We ordered their cold cuts and for the price, the components of the board blended well together. For the pasta, the puttanesca was good but it would've felt more complete if there's a slice or 2 of bread (I think they call this scarpetta?). But for the beef salpicao, I tried a slice of it and it was so tender, I said I wanted to go back just for it. It's much more tender than any beef salpicao I have ever tried before. Not sure why other reviewers said it's not tender. Maybe we got lucky with our batch of beef or they just have a really high standard for beef salpicao tenderness, but it was good for me. SERVICE: They catered us well. I really have no complaints for their service. The food came relatively fast. We waited for less than 30 minutes and that was lunchtime on a Sunday. This would probably vary on a different day and time, and would also depend on the number of orders. We had 2 mains, 1 appetizer, and 2 drinks. PLACE: We chose to dine outside because we wanted to be surrounded by greenery. It was nice and relaxing. It also wasn't hot at the time we dined. Otherwise, we would've stayed inside which would equally be a good experience since it's also cozy there. A suggestion would be to upgrade the tables and chairs outside. It would add more to a rustic sort of experience and elevate the atmosphere to the same level their foods have.

It took almost an hour to get a pizza because they served mine to the wrong table and only realised it when i inquired about it after 45min had passed. Then, once i paid my bill, the waiter didn't bring change and receipt, and i again had to inquire about it 20min later to see it coming. You can find a better place and better pizzas in Davao.

food is great! we love the pizza and pasta. parking space can accommodate only around 5-6 vehicles so you may find yourself parking from a distance when the place is full.

We offered to help them transfer the table and was later on allowed to dine in because we really wanted to try the restau because of the hype. In the end, it was not worth the hassle.

Was in the place 3/10/24. After 30 minutes of waiting, was told that a dish ordered was not listed by the waiter and hence not prepared. Other dishes were also of small serving and not worth the price

Went here to catch up with some friends that I haven't seen in a long time. We ate here for lunch but ended up staying nearly 5 hours because we got immersed in our conversation. The staff was pretty accommodating and they never pressured us to leave even though we really didn't order anything else from the menu. Kami nalang yung nahiya kasi nag overstay na kami ng grabe and there were other customers waiting for a table. The food was good. The waiter was very helpful in helping us decide and was very patient. We ended up trying the Truffle Pasta (although it was a bit too salty for me, but still good) and had a few of their frappes and cheesecakes. The ambience was very warm and welcoming and they had clean facilities. We wanted to try their famous chocolate fudge but unfortunately they were out of stock so hopefully when we come back we can try some. Highly recommended!

They have the most reasonable price for a fancy meal. I love their salads and dishes. They also make wonderful halaya ube. You don't need to look for expensive places to find a fancy meal. Lara Mia is the best!

Their prices are worth every bite! This cozy, little café is the place to be if one is looking for a quick, hunger-satisfying food. Have tried their Three Cheese Panini, Half Roast Chicken, Caesar Salad, Callos, Osso Buco (a bit oily for me but tastes fine), Someone to Lava cake, and Creme Brulee Cheesecake..and all of these a must-try! I'm not a fan of parmesan cheese but I LOVE the caesar salad the best! :) Keep up the good work, chefs!

Had been here twice - 1st with family and 2nd time with good friends. This is a pretty new cafe/bistro in Juna Subd which is not too far from our place, about 15 minutes drive away. You wouldn't miss this yellow bldg/ structure with beautifully landscaped lawn infront and of course, their ubiquitous signage where I made that "blogger pose!" I guess this was an old, ancestral house turned to a quaint, homey resto. Wood tables & chairs, pastel-colored decors and sliding doors dominate the interiors. The curiosity in me also explored the back of the resto - vines, trees, black wrought-iron chairs and yes, would you believe -a yellow bike! There's also a side dining portion which is open and good for groups or families. Get that feeling like you're just dining in your lanai? That's it! This place is so IG-worrthy but more than that, food is yummy & very tasteful. The pizza ( 4-cheese pizza) and pasta ( truffle pasta) we tried are so good and filling. There are rice meals, too, which we can try next time. However, it is worthy to mention that the food is quite pricey and good for sharing for people whose appetite is not that big. Otherwise, you have to have that whole meal/dish to yourself. Next time, we will try to have a cup of coffee to go with their cakes, too. My TIP: Don't ever skip the desserts! My husband loves the choco molten lava! Before I forget, guess what was playing while we were eating - Mario Lanza's "opera-ish music" as per my hubby who knew him so well ( sorry millennials if you do not know him, just Google it, hehe...). This kind of music gives this place a different vibe - on a Sunday lunch at that. 😂😆 All in all, worth a visit and maybe just try to be early on weekends as place gets to be pretty full. Definitely we will be back - two-thumbs up!l

Pasta was al dente but the portion is not for sharing. Beef salpicao was spot on as well. Tenderloin tips were soft and chewy and the garlic bits on top of it all were a good addition.
